script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The passage says Jeconiah had been exiled from Jerusalem, but it does not say he was already in Babylon when the letter went out.
The passage says Jeconiah was exiled before the letter was sent, not necessarily before it was written.
The explanation is flat and generic, with little of Papa Dorin's voice.
Jonah is introduced without saying who he is.
“Half-hearted won't do it” makes a claim about what would happen with a half-hearted search. The verse states when they will find the LORD, not that additional outcome.
The explanation is generic and repeats that sacrifices are not mentioned without adding much of Papa Dorin's personality.
“Nobody's left out” goes beyond the promise to gather them from all the nations and places.
The LORD promises to gather them from all the places, but He does not name every place individually.
